canPlace.title: Can Place
canPlace.description: True if every item resolved and the order is within credit, so it can be placed.

creditWarning.title: Credit Warning
creditWarning.description: A warning if the estimated total exceeds the outlet available credit. Empty if fine.

draftLines.title: Draft Lines
draftLines.description: Each priced line: product, quantity, rate and estimated line total. One per line.

mustSellWarning.title: Must-Sell Warning
mustSellWarning.description: A warning if required must-sell products are missing from the order. Empty if fine.

stockWarning.title: Stock Warning
stockWarning.description: A stock note for the order. Stock is validated when the order is submitted.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: A ready-to-read draft summary that ends by asking the rep to confirm. Prefer this for the reply.

totalAmount.title: Total Amount
totalAmount.description: Estimated order total, in rupees. Final pricing and schemes are applied when the order is placed.
